part.text:
Implemented the fix in `src/diff/index.js`.

The buggy loop reset `_stateCallbacks` inside its own iteration, discarding all but the first callback. State callbacks are now collected after render (and in the `shouldComponentUpdate` bailout path), preserving all of them and ensuring they run after `componentDidUpdate`.

Validated:
- `componentDidMount.test.js`: 2 passed
- `lifecycle.test.js`: 17 passed
- Combined `components` + `lifecycles`: 123 passed, 2 skipped
